summary: John's 4th great-uncle; brother of Maria Anna Birkenmayer; emigrant to Sandusky, Ohio.
bio: Born 15 Mar 1842, baptized 19 Mar 1842 at Munzingen (No. 6): 'Joseph Birkenmayer, ehelicher Sohn des Servatius Birkenmayer, hiesigen Bürgers und Glasers, und der Agatha Heizler'; witnesses Gabriel Ott, farmer, and Johann Schell, teacher. The Ancestry index (snippet) has a Joseph Birkenmeier, b. 15 Mar 1842 'Münzingen', Breisgau, parents Servatius Birkenmayer and Agatha Heitzler, d. 3 Nov 1904 Sandusky, Erie Co., Ohio — the clue that led to Munzingen. Munzingen had an emigrant pipeline to northern Ohio. Not in the 1889 History of Erie County biographies (B).
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, Standesbücher 1840–1870; 631 images; record id 5-480947), births 1842 No. 6 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-62
openQuestions: Sandusky Register obituary Nov 1904 (Hayes Presidential Center obituary index https://www.rbhayes.org/) — may name Munzingen and a sister in Hazleton.
